description_zh: 调用DescribeLiveStreamWatermarks查询水印模板列表
kebab_example: aliyun live describe-live-stream-watermarks --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain live.yourdomain.com --key-word 445409ec-7eaa-461d-8f29-4bec2eb90000 --page-number 1 --page-size 100 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLiveStreamWatermarks

parameters.help_en: The keyword for the search. You can specify a template ID or name. Fuzzy search is supported for names
parameters.help_zh: 搜索关键词。模板ID或名称，名称支持模糊搜索
parameters.name: key_word

parameters.help_en: The page number. The default value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页的页数。不传默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of templates to return on each page. The default value is 100
parameters.help_zh: 每⻚模板数值，不传默认为100
parameters.name: page_size

Total.description_en: The total number of matching entries

Description.description_en: The custom description of the watermark

Height.description_en: The height of the watermark image, in pixels. This value is relative to `RefHeight` and is scaled proportionally with the actual video resolution

OffsetCorner.description_en:
The anchor point for the watermark's position. Valid values:

TopLeft

TopRight

BottomLeft

BottomRight
OffsetCorner.description_zh:
水印位置。
TopLeft：左上。

TopRight：右上。

BottomLeft：左下。

BottomRight：右下

PictureUrl.description_en: The URL of the watermark image

RefHeight.description_en: The reference height of the video background, in pixels

RefWidth.description_en: The reference width of the video background, in pixels

RuleCount.description_en: The number of watermark rules configured for the domain
RuleCount.description_zh: Domain下配置的水印规则数量

TemplateId.description_en: The ID of the watermark template

Transparency.description_en: The opacity of the watermark. Value range: `0` (fully transparent) to `255` (fully opaque)
Transparency.description_zh: 水印透明度，数值越小越透明。取值：0~255

Type.description_zh:
水印类型。

0：图片（目前只支持图片）。

1：文字

XOffset.description_en:
The X-axis offset of the watermark, in pixels.

Relative to RefWidth. If OffsetCorner is TopLeft, XOffset is the horizontal distance between the top‑left corner of the watermark and the top‑left corner of the background video. Positive X points to the right
XOffset.description_zh:
⽔印X轴偏移，单位：px。
相对于参考背景宽RefWidth， 如果选择的是TopLeft，那么XOffset是指⽔印图⽚的左上⻆和背景视频的左上⻆的相对位置X。其中坐标指向背景视频中⼼的⽅向为正⽅向，即X轴的正⽅向是向右

YOffset.description_en:
The Y-axis offset of the watermark, in pixels.

Relative to RefHeight. If OffsetCorner is TopLeft, YOffset is the vertical distance between the top‑left corner of the watermark and the top‑left corner of the background video. Positive Y points downward
YOffset.description_zh:
⽔印Y轴偏移，单位：px。
相对于参考背景⾼RefHeight，如果选择的是TopLeft，那么YOffset是指⽔印图⽚的左上⻆和背景视频的左上⻆的相对位置Y。其中坐标指向背景视频中⼼的⽅向为正⽅向，即Y轴的正⽅向是向下
